g.text: Worker: one job at a time
Two candidates, one kept on dev
PostgreSQL 18.6, database datapilot, schema ops: the shared state
events, event duplicates, jobs, runs (with any trace refusal), run events, approvals,
posts, control, budgets, autonomy policy, knowledge versions, experiments (with the
gate's recorded baseline), promotion decisions, improvement requests, live sessions,
analyzer candidates, rehearsal verifications, reset archives and their rows,
schema migrations (written by the owner role only)
